file_stem: RWB E1 056 Run books and monitoring for every Epic 1 job
title: Run books and monitoring for every Epic 1 Workbench job
status_text: Ready. Reads a Section B view (ACE-001)
goal: Every job has an owner, a run book and monitoring, so ops can restart it and see a late ACE batch
why: At 06:00, ops must know whether to rerun JOB-02 or wait for ACE. The monitor shows each job's last run beside the ACE business date.
triggers: rwb.job.run at each job start and end

writes.note: 16 rows: one per job, owner, run book link

stores: Quartz + P1 job run log (TE-007); Log Analytics workbook 'Recovery jobs' + alert rules; run books docs/operations/runbooks/<jobId>.md

path.text: Run book: rerun from failed step

rules: BR1: no inbound load job is catalogued
BR2: each run book has 8 sections
BR5: rerun of a completed job and business date is refused
BR6: a run book naming a public table fails the build
risks: Missing run book or section -> pipeline fails (MSG-P2-005)
Late ACE batch -> STALE, EV-27, job WAITING (MSG-P1-001)
example: JOB-02 fails at 05:40 on 2026-11-30 (v_ace_account returned no row at 90 DPD)
